subject: Decision knots & acceptance sprint: Scout pilot MAP
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Scout pilot MAP & acceptance sprint — please review

Team,

Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan for the Scout pilot (attached: scout-map-draft.xlsx). High level asks: define measurable success criteria, explicit exit gates, and a compact set of acceptance tests we can run during the eval sprint. My assumptions below — please flag anything missing.

Proposed evaluation sprint: 3 weeks (pilot window + smoke + verification).
Core success criteria (draft):
- Functional: end-to-end ingestion -> inference -> app response for 90% of representative traffic patterns
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450ms for sample dataset (seq len 128)
- Quality: mean human-rated relevance >= 4/5 on a 30-case prompt set
- Security/Privacy: no PII persisted in logs; KMS-managed keys for customer data

Exit gates (stop conditions):
- If latency 95p > 700ms for more than 2 consecutive days -> pause rollout and trigger perf deep-dive
- If concordance (human-rated) < 3.5 -> fail-forward to model tuning step

Acceptance tests (examples):
1) Smoke: 1000 synthetic requests across five routes — pass if 95% success and no errors
2) Latency profile: run production-like replay (1hr) with p95 and p99 metric capture
3) Data handling: KMS key rotation and log redaction verification
4) Regression: 30-case prompt set against baseline model for relevance scoring

Owners (proposal):
- Sales/CS owner: Ben Carter (deal lead)
- Technical owner (eng/ops): Marissa Cole (runtime + infra)
- Evidence / QA owner: Grace O'Connor (test harness + human eval)

Ask: please review and comment by EOD tomorrow. I plan to send a customer-facing MAP with these changes once we align.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachment: scout-map-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet: MAP lanes, owners, timeline)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Scout pilot MAP & acceptance sprint — please review

Thanks Hannah — this is a solid start. A couple quick notes from the deal side:
- Scout is focused on two outcomes: reduce clinician triage time and ensure PHI is never exposed in observability. That maps to the Quality and Security criteria you listed.
- Pricing & commitment: Scout asked to see a deterministic acceptance statement tied to go/no-go for the three-week PO — we should make the sales acceptance clause explicit.

I'll loop Priya and Tom if you want me to send the customer-facing MAP. Also recommend we add a specific data retention test: verify retention TTLs for customer sandbox are 30 days and confirm automatic purge.

I can own follow-up with legal on the acceptance clause.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Priya Rao <priya@scouthealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@scouthealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Scout pilot MAP & acceptance sprint — Scout feedback

Hi Hannah / Ben,

Thanks for the draft. A few pieces of feedback from our security and product teams (quick list):
1) Timeline: we prefer a 4-week eval window so we can run our own clinical scenario pass/fail tests — will that work?
2) Latency: 450ms p95 is aggressive for some of our longer sequences. Can you provide a p95 target for seq len 128 and a separate p95 for seq len 256? We need to see both.
3) Data handling: we need SOC2 evidence and confirmation that logs sent to our workspace exclude PII. We'll attach our checklist (attached: scout-eval-constraints.pdf).
4) Acceptance tests we care about:
   - End-to-end correctness on 40 clinical prompts (we will supply the set)
   - P95 latency (seq128) <= 500ms; p95 (seq256) <= 850ms
   - Retention TTL verification (30 days) and a documentation page on data deletion flows
5) Rollback trigger: if quality drops >15% relative to baseline for two consecutive days, we expect an immediate rollback and root-cause call.

If you can update the MAP and send back a v2 with specific owners and a DocuSign for the MAP + acceptance clause, we can sign and proceed.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Product
Scout Health

Attachment: scout-eval-constraints.pdf (Scout internal checklist)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@scouthealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Scout pilot MAP & acceptance sprint — updated MAP and next steps

Priya — great, thanks for the clear constraints. I've incorporated your asks and attached v2 (scout-map-v2.xlsx). Key changes:
- Evaluation window: extended to 4 weeks (week 1: smoke + onboarding, weeks 2-3: run tests and remediations, week 4: verification + signoff)
- Latency targets: p95 (seq128) <= 500ms; p95 (seq256) <= 850ms (we'll publish measurement harness and replay scripts)
- Acceptance tests now include your 40-case clinical set and an automated retention TTL verification for sandbox environments
- Rollback/stop conditions: included both the quality >15% drop trigger and the latency breach trigger you called out.

Owners: Ben (customer liaison + acceptance clause), Marissa (runtime/infra), Grace (evaluation harness & human scoring), Hannah (program owner).

Next steps:
1) I will upload v2 to HubSpot and send this to Scout with a short DocuSign for the MAP + acceptance clause (link below). Please review the legal phrasing around the acceptance clause — Ben, Marissa, can you give quick sign-off?
2) Scout confirms the 40-case prompt set and signs the DocuSign by Sep 9 to keep the timeline.

DocuSign (MAP + acceptance clause): https://www.docusign.com/Sign?token=abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/3457

Attachment: scout-map-v2.xlsx (MAP v2: owners, timeline, acceptance tests)

Thanks — I'll wait for your internal OK before sending the customer doc.

Hannah
